answer: Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a pigment debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the prism totals, and the plume anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 23 units per epoch, sustaining 323 aliases for 59 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
